race.comment: DAMAS (11) was well fancied for the new yard with a courageous third over 1004m at this course. Ready for this trip and expected to go close with the senior rider going aboard. MISTER BIANCO (1) holding his form and saves his best for this trip. Took control early in the small field with a fighting nose win over 1200m at the Gold Coast. Faces a few hurdles but too good to dismiss. MOGUL MONARCH (2) excellent fresh gelding who sets-up well for this with the two solid trials. Savaged the line from the wide gate with a narrow second over 1200m at Gosford in BM78 class five months ago. Tempo suits and not without each way prospects. PRIDE TO FOLLOW (6) capable on her day and like the way she attacked the line first up with a respectable third over 900m at Newcastle in the Hurricane. Maps well and goes even better second up.
